narrative.overview: Resumify is a craftsperson's workshop for one document that matters: someone's career, told well. The system reads as inked and considered — deep brown surfaces and serif headlines borrowed from the language of a well-typeset page — rather than the glassy, gradient-lit dashboard of a generic AI-SaaS wrapper. A single emerald accent stands in for the atelier's one tool that matters: it marks progress, success, and the moments where the product actively helps (scores, checkmarks, the premium "unlimited" tier). Everything else stays quiet — warm cream surfaces, hairline borders, soft infrequent shadows — so the accent and the user's own words keep the room's attention. This is a candidate-facing tool, not recruiter-facing admin software, and it should never feel like either. It explicitly rejects the interchangeable template-picker aesthetic of Canva-style builders, the sterile chrome of corporate HR/ATS systems, and the cream-background/gradient-text/glass-card default that most AI tools reach for in 2025-26. Warmth here comes from typography, color restraint, and calm confident copy — not from decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-neutral surfaces (#fdf8f4 family) with deep-brown ink (#4f3b2f), never pure black-on-white.
One accent color (#0F6E56 emerald) used sparingly and consistently for progress, success, and links.
Newsreader serif headlines paired with Manrope sans body and interface labels.
Flat-by-default surfaces with hairline borders; shadow only as a response to hover, modals, or the premium moment.
A distinct premium-gold (#A16207) role kept separate from emerald, reserved only for Premium-tier signals.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Emerald (#0F6E56) is the only saturated accent in the interface. Reach for brown-at-opacity or cream first; use emerald only for progress, success, or the primary action.

rules.name: The Premium-Gold Exception
rules.body: Premium-tier signals use a dedicated gold (#A16207), never emerald and never a gradient. Gold means "you're on Premium"; emerald means "this worked."

rules.name: The Serif-Headline Rule
rules.body: Any h1-h4 is font-headline (Newsreader) by default; never set a sans headline.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: No element carries a shadow in its default state except modals. If a shadow is visible before hover/interaction, remove it.

dos: Do keep emerald (#0F6E56) to a single accent role per screen.
Do default every card and panel to flat with a hairline border and add shadow only on hover, in modals, or for the Premium moment.
Do set headlines in Newsreader and body/UI text in Manrope.
Do use the underline input style for text fields; keep validation inline (icon + message swap).
Do maintain min-h-11 min-w-11 (44px) tap targets on every button and icon button.
Do use the premium-gold role exclusively for Premium-tier signals, kept visually distinct from emerald.
donts: Don't build a wall of interchangeable template-picker cards with no guidance or point of view.
Don't make any surface feel like sterile corporate HR/ATS software.
Don't default to the cream-background + gradient-text + glass-card AI-SaaS look.
Don't add a resting shadow to any element that isn't a modal.
Don't use emerald and gold interchangeably.
Don't use border-left/border-right colored stripes as a callout or card accent.
Don't round cards or sections past rounded-2xl (16px); full-pill rounding is reserved for buttons, badges, and avatars only.
